column1: # Pinned release binaries of the dc-mcp module. Columns (tab separated): name, version, machine (uname -m), sha256, url.
# The sha256 values are the digests GitHub publishes for each release asset (`gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/releases/tags/<tag>`,
# field `digest`), and the x86_64 ones were also compared with the binaries already running on ubuntu-pc (equal). The installer
# refuses any download whose sha256 differs. To bump a version: change the version, the url and the digest together.
